build_variational_sorting_net: build a python module that creates a VariationalSortingNet instance with a communication pattern and entropy regularization strategy
run_smooth_sort: run the VariationalSortingNet sort method to compute a smoothed sorted version of a JAX array
compute_smoothed_quantile: compute the smoothed alpha quantile of a JAX array using the quantile method with a dispersion parameter
compute_smoothed_median: compute the smoothed median of a JAX array using the median method with a dispersion parameter
compute_sort_permutation: compute the smoothed sorting permutation matrix of a JAX array using the sortperm method
